text: This report recommends approval of an application to amend the Zoning By-law to permit a 35-storey (108 metres, excluding the mechanical penthouse) infill residential building to replace the surface parking lot while retaining the existing 12-storey apartment building. The proposed building has 363 dwelling units and includes a residential gross floor area of 25,082 square metres. The portion of the site that is within the Toronto and Region Conservation Authority Regulated Area will be zoned Open Space - Natural Zone.
